question: Who is declared the revealer of all scriptures in relation to the wide-eyed goddess?
premises: The speaker says I and you
The goddess is addressed as wide-eyed one
The revealer of all scriptures is identified
inference: The speaker, together with the goddess, is the revealer of all scriptures.
uncertainties: Whether avatārakaḥ applies to I, you, or both is syntactically ambiguous
plain_english: O wide-eyed one, I and you are the revealer of all scriptures.
